description.value: The Society for the Preservation of Antique Radio in Canada (SPARC) operates a public museum on the historic Riverview Hospital grounds in Coquitlam, preserving radio and electronic communications artifacts from the spark era through to television with an emphasis on Canadian history. The site offers hands-on restoration workshops and repair services for old radios, and the sprawling Riverview arboretum and heritage architecture make for a pleasant explore on foot or by bike. Admission is by donation.
